name: Yonaguni (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Yonaguni town emblem in white: a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes with a vertical bar.
history: Municipal flag of Yonaguni, a town in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 28 December 1965.

features.role: Yonaguni town emblem — a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes with a vertical bar
